{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|a belief droids held|the central region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometimes known as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]}}
The '''Core''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] belief that all droids were connected, even though they came from different manufacturers and were of different degrees. Many thought this was a droid attempt to build a connection to the world around them, much like an organic being might feel connected to the ecosystem on their home [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was considered to be a [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]], linking droids throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]].

Some droids thought it might be possible to manipulate their connection to the Core, much like [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
